caption: A single uncut realistic waist-up shot in a train station corridor. The same adult woman faces the camera and begins slowly turning to her right. She has a copper bob haircut with blunt bangs, olive skin, green eyes, a small silver nose stud, and a calm expression. She wears a navy wool coat, a mustard yellow scarf with thin black stripes, black leather gloves, and carries a square tan satchel at her right side. Smooth continuous motion, no scene cut, fluorescent station lighting, shallow depth of field.
